proof.name: Bloop
proof.description: An AI concierge app that finds events and things to do in your city. You chat in plain language and it proposes real events from a live catalogue, never invented ones. Italian first, with English, and a web admin for curating the catalogue.
proof.demonstrates: We can build an AI assistant your users talk to in plain language, and have it answer from your own live data.

proof.name: Washiiba
proof.description: A full marketplace platform for laundry, built end to end: a customer mobile app for ordering, pickup windows and live order status, a supplier web portal where laundries accept and handle orders, and an admin back office for managing orders, suppliers and users.
proof.demonstrates: We can build every side of a marketplace: the app customers use, the portal suppliers work in and the back office the operator runs it from.

proof.name: Kerf
proof.stage: case study on public data, not yet validated in the field, no paying customer
proof.description: Kerf turns free national LiDAR (IGN LiDAR HD in France) into a ranked list of overhead-line spans where vegetation is inside the clearance zone, measured in metres, then a work order for trimming crews. It is made for small electricity distributors and vegetation management contractors. A LiDAR processing pipeline, a web map viewer with the ranked span list and per-span measurements, work order export (CSV) and a printable report. The case-study run covers 345 spans on 28.4 km of overhead line: 829.5 million LiDAR points, scanned in June 2021, processed in 83 seconds on one server.
proof.demonstrates: We can take raw public data to a ranked, measured result and a work order.
proof.data_attribution: Map data: LiDAR HD and orthophotos © IGN, Licence Ouverte 2.0. Example data.

proof.name: Recovery Room
proof.stage: pilot, live at a gym in Cagliari
proof.description: Booking for a gym's massage chairs and pressotherapy. A booking page for phones, Italian first with English: pick a seat and a time, with no app and no password. A staff page with the day's schedule, no-show counts and the member list. Confirmation emails come from the gym's own address and bookings sync to its Google Calendar.
proof.demonstrates: We can get a small business a working tool in days, on its real member list.
